given: a Property whose business date is D
then: refused with 55000: a day closes only once the clock has ended it, so a close never moves app.property_today()

situation: Closing a day that has not begun
given: a Property whose business date is D
then: refused with 55000 like CD-S1-01

given: a cutoff of 04:00, the clock at 02:00 local, and D - 1 already closed
when: a Staff Member opens Close the day
then: the screen prepares D: its open items are listed and resolvable, and it says D can be closed after 04:00; nothing is offered to close

situation: The first close at a Property
given: a Property with no close at all
then: it closes: the first close anchors the Property's history

given: a Property with no close at all
then: refused with 55000: the first close is the day before today

given: a Property whose last close is D - 2
then: refused with 55000: D waits for D - 1

given: a Property whose last close is today - 5
when: a Staff Member opens Close the day
then: the day offered is today - 4, the screen says four days are waiting, and closing it offers today - 3 next

situation: A cutoff change onto a closed day
given: a Property whose last close is D and whose business date is D + 1
when: its cutoff is changed so that its business date becomes D
then: refused with RZ001, a business day is closed: today cannot move back onto a closed day

situation: A time zone change onto a closed day
given: a Property whose last close is D and whose business date is D + 1
when: its time zone is changed so that its business date becomes D
then: refused with RZ001 like CD-S1-08

situation: A cutoff change that keeps today after the last close
given: a Property whose last close is D and whose business date is D + 1
when: its cutoff is changed and its business date stays D + 1
then: allowed

situation: A late arrival after their day closed
given: a Guest booked for D, D closed with them left open, and their booking still running
when: they arrive after the cutoff and are checked in
then: the check-in succeeds and is dated today; the close keeps what it recorded

situation: Withdrawing a check-in on a closed day
given: a Stay that began on D and D is closed
when: a Staff Member withdraws the check-in
then: refused with RZ001, a business day is closed, and the desk is told so: withdrawing it would put an unarrived booking back into a day that is closed

situation: Withdrawing a check-in on an open day
given: a Stay that began today
when: a Staff Member withdraws the check-in
then: it succeeds as before: only a closed day is protected

situation: A Stay begun on a closed day
given: D is closed
when: anybody, the owner included, writes a Stay that begins on D
then: refused with RZ001: nothing new is dated on a closed day

situation: A departure on a closed day
given: D is closed and a Guest is in house
when: their Stay is ended on D
then: refused with RZ001; a departure today is allowed

situation: A check-in or check-out in flight at the cutoff
given: a Stay write that began before the cutoff and a close of that day
then: they serialise on the Property's lock, shared for the Stay and exclusive for the close: a Stay written first is counted by the close, and one arriving after it is refused with RZ001 and succeeds when pressed again on the new day

situation: Nothing new is dated on a closed day
given: D is closed
when: somebody checks in, checks out or books
then: each is dated today or later, as it already was: check-in and check-out date themselves by app.property_today() and a booking cannot start before it

given: today - 1 has nothing open at the Property
when: a Staff Member closes it without a reason
then: one close is recorded naming them, with no exceptions and no reason

given: Stays that began on D, departed on D, stayed through the night of D, and one withdrawn
then: arrived counts Stays begun on D and not withdrawn, departed counts Stays departed on D, and nights occupied counts Stays in house through the night of D, a Guest past their departure included

given: a Staff Member closes D
when: the stamping trigger counts Stays and Folios and lists Reservations
then: they are every row at the Property: a closer must reach it, and Staff read stays, reservations and folios by reach alone. Nothing narrows a closer below the Property today, so the two cannot diverge and no behaviour can tell them apart; the read policies themselves are pinned instead, and the day one narrows, the trigger must become a definer

given: a Guest departed on or before D with their Folio still open
when: D is closed without a reason
then: it closes: an open Folio is reported, never blocking, because nothing can take a payment yet; folios_left_open counts it

situation: Items left open without a reason
given: a confirmed booking whose first night was D or earlier and nobody arrived
when: a Staff Member closes D without a reason
then: refused with 23514 by business_day_closes_exceptions_need_a_reason

situation: Items left open with a reason
given: one booking not arrived and one Guest past their departure, on D
when: a Staff Member closes D with a reason
then: it closes; exceptions lists both by kind and id, the reason is stored, and the audit record carries it

situation: A request whose night has come
given: a requested booking whose first night was D or earlier
then: it is open: only cancelling resolves it

given: an in-house Stay whose departure was D or earlier
then: it is open: check them out first or give a reason

given: an in-house Stay whose departure is today
then: it is not open: their night of today - 1 is paid for and they have until today to leave

given: an in-house Stay with no departure date
then: it is never open

situation: A booking for a later night
given: a confirmed booking whose first night is after D
then: it is not open

given: two Staff Members
when: both close D at the same moment
then: one close exists; the second is told the day is already closed (23505), not an error

situation: A close and a withdrawal of its day
given: a Stay that began on D
when: one Staff Member closes D while another withdraws that check-in
then: they serialise on the Property's lock (namespace 3): either the withdrawal lands first and the close sees the booking open, or the close lands first and the withdrawal is refused

given: a role without front_desk.close_day: housekeeping, finance, or an Organization's check-in-only role
then: refused with 42501

given: the shipped roles
then: owner, manager and front desk hold front_desk.close_day; finance and housekeeping do not

given: a Property in another Organization
when: a Staff Member closes one of its days
then: refused with 42501 before anything about it is read: the same answer as a Property that does not exist

situation: A Property outside the closer's reach
given: a Staff Member assigned to another Property of the same Organization
when: they close a day at this one
then: refused with 42501 by the stamp's caller check, which runs first for every Staff Member; the insert policy carries the same gate (ADR 0012) and cannot be seen to act while the stamp does, which a sabotage of each alone confirms

given: a lapsed Subscription, no front_office Entitlement, or the front_desk capability off
when: a Staff Member closes a due day
then: refused with 42501, each asserted; bound twice like CD-S1-31, by the stamp's caller check first and the insert policy behind it

given: closes at two Properties
when: a Staff Member who reaches one of them reads closes
then: they see that Property's closes and not the other's

given: a close
when: anybody, the owner included, updates or deletes it
then: refused with 42501 by a statement trigger

given: ranza_app
when: it inserts a close naming counts, exceptions, a closer, or when it closed
then: refused with 42501: the insert grant is the Organization, the Property, the day and a reason; the rest is the database's

given: a close made by mistake
when: a Staff Member looks for undo
then: there is none in this slice: the dialog says a close is final until reopening exists (CD-DEF-02), and never that it cannot be undone

given: a day with Guests in house
then: nothing is posted to any Folio and no amount is recorded: room nights are s3, and s3 waits on a rate

given: a Staff Member closes D
then: an audit record business_day.closed names them, the day and any reason, and business_day.closed is published with ids and a date only

given: nothing is open on the day offered
then: every step reads done and Close is offered without asking for a reason

given: items are open on the day offered
then: the dialog says how many items will be recorded as left open and asks for a reason before it will close

given: several days are waiting
then: it names the oldest day and how many are waiting

given: yesterday is closed
then: it says today is still being worked and can be closed after the cutoff, and lists today's open items so the night shift can clear them

given: a Staff Member without front_desk.close_day reads the screen
then: the checklist is shown and Close is not offered; the policy still decides

given: open items on screen
when: the Staff Member acts on one
then: a booking not arrived offers mark no-show when the viewer holds front_desk.cancel and it is confirmed, cancel when they hold front_desk.cancel, and check-in on the arrivals screen when it can still be checked in; a Guest past departure links to departures

given: any day
then: step three says room nights are posted once rates exist and never blocks the close

given: any screen state in any locale
then: no copy mentions Accounting or says a close cannot be undone

given: the day on screen was closed by another desk or the worker
then: they are told it was already closed and the screen shows the next day

given: Turkish, English or Arabic
then: all copy comes from the catalogue, and Arabic mirrors by construction through logical utilities

given: closes by a Staff Member and by the worker
then: the recent closes say who closed each, or that it closed automatically, with its counts

given: a Property with and without the front_desk capability
then: Close the day is under Front office where the front desk is and absent where it is not

given: departed Guests whose Folio is still open
then: they are listed with their balance, marked as not blocking

situation: The worker closes a quiet day
given: a Property whose next due day has nothing open
then: the day closes naming the job business_day.close and no person, with the same counts a desk's close would record

situation: The worker leaves an open day alone
given: a Property whose next due day has items open
then: nothing is written; the day waits for the desk

given: a due day whose last open item is resolved at 09:00
then: the day closes on that pass: the worker tries every pass after the cutoff

given: a Property whose last close is yesterday
then: nothing is due and nothing is written

given: a Property with no close at all
then: only the day before today is due

given: two worker replicas
when: both close the same due day
then: one close exists and the other reports already_closed

given: a Staff Member and the worker
when: both close the same due day
then: one close exists; the desk is told it is already closed

given: a lapsed Subscription, no front_office Entitlement, the front_desk capability off, or an archived Property
then: nothing is due there and nothing is closed, even when the close is asked for directly

situation: Who may ask what is due
given: ranza_app, ranza_auth and ranza_worker
then: only ranza_worker may, and it answers ids and a date and nothing else: the second cross-Organization read ADR 0018 names

situation: The worker's close outside its context
given: ranza_worker with no worker context or another Organization's
then: refused with 42501

situation: The front desk calling the worker's close
given: ranza_app
then: refused: only ranza_worker holds execute

given: one due Property whose close raises
then: the others still close, and the failure is reported with its Property

given: a Property with three quiet days waiting
then: one day closes per pass, oldest first

given: the worker closes a day
then: business_day.closed is published with the same payload a desk's close publishes

given: the worker closes a day
then: closed_by is null and closed_by_job is business_day.close; no audit record is written, because audit.records needs a person (CD-DEF-05)

given: a worker pass
then: when it closed or failed anything it logs due, closed, open and failed, and each failure with its Property; a pass never overlaps the last, and shutdown lets the current one finish

situation: A close that fails for another reason
given: a lock timeout, an object in use, or anything else in class 55 at one Property
then: it is raised and reported as that Property's failure, never answered not_due, which a pass does not log

given: Guests in house through the night of D, and Residents
then: one line per Guest Stay for D; Residents are excluded because they are billed monthly

given: D's room nights are posted
then: nothing new is posted: the line's source key, the Stay and the business date, is unique

given: room nights exist
then: D's room nights must be posted first, and the close records their total

given: a Property without the finance capability
then: nothing is posted for it, and the close says so

given: a Guest leaves early or stays on
then: out of this feature: the rates feature owns it, as CO-S1-31 already says

given: nothing in the product has a price
then: blocks: s3. RANZ-31 decides what a night costs; this feature invents no pricing rule (blueprint 15.10).

situation: A dated and keyed Folio line
given: folio_lines has no business date and no source key
then: blocks: s3. A line needs the business date it belongs to (ADR 0021) and a unique source key so a retried posting posts nothing (ADR 0020).

situation: Extend a Stay by a night
given: a Guest past their departure who is staying on
when: the desk extends them from the checklist
then: deferred to amending a booking (roadmap, cancelling and amending): no command changes a Stay's dates, so the checklist links to check-out only

given: a close made by mistake
then: deferred: front_desk.reopen_day for owner and manager, a reason, and a new revision written beside the close rather than a change to it

given: a reopened day
then: deferred with CD-DEF-02: the correction is a revision, and the earlier close reads as superseded

given: business_day.closed is published
then: deferred to blueprint 5.10: nothing consumes the event yet

situation: The worker in the audit log
given: the worker closes a day
then: deferred: audit.records requires a person, and ADR 0018 names the job on the row instead; the Close the day screen shows automatic closes meanwhile

given: a booking not arrived when the cutoff passes
then: deferred, and deliberately not done: the desk decides whether a Guest is late or not coming, and the worker closes only a day with nothing open

situation: Changing the cutoff from a screen
given: an Organization wants a different cutoff
then: deferred to a Property settings screen; until then it is changed in SQL, and CD-S1-08 still holds
